sloka: स्वधीतं दत्तमिष्टं चाप्यैश्वर्यं परिपालितम् ।आयुर्निरामयं प्राप्तं सुधर्मः प्रापितः पथि ।। ७.६.४० ॥
transliteration: svadhītaṁ dattamiṣṭaṁ cāpyaiśvaryaṁ paripālitam ।āyurnirāmayaṁ prāptaṁ sudharmaḥ prāpitaḥ pathi ।। 7.6.40 ॥

translations.english: Then, Sumali and Mali, having heard the words of Malyavan, spoke to their elder brother, just as Bhaga and Amsha would speak to Indra.
